Docs.Title: Sec. 1-101. - Code designated and cited.
Docs.Content:
This Code shall be known as the "Billings, Montana City Code," and it shall be sufficient to refer to this Code as the "BMCC", in any prosecution for the violation of any provision thereof or any proceeding at law or equity. It shall also be sufficient to designate any ordinance adding to, amending, correcting or repealing all or any part or portion thereof as an addition to, amendment to, correction of, or repeal of the "Billings, Montana City Code." Further reference may be had to the chapters, articles, divisions, sections and subsections of the "Billings, Montana City Code" and such reference shall apply to that numbered chapter, article, division, section or subsection as it appears in this Code.

(Code 1967, § 1.04.010)

State Law reference— Authority for codification and revision of ordinances, MCA 7-5-103(2).
